home-is-the-cwd-the-source-of-the-config.description: the dotfiles repo's working copy at `~/dev/dotfiles` is `home/`'s source; chezmoi deploys from it, the manual reads from it, the record lives beside it
home-is-the-cwd-the-source-of-the-config.read_when: running a command that names a path, or writing one that another reader will copy

the-board-stays-the-board.description: the PRD board at pearde/ is a work-in-flight engine — memos record what is settled, the board records what is open
the-board-stays-the-board.read_when: deciding whether a question is a memo, a work item, or a board PRD; or chasing a record that has gone stale
